description: This file provides utilities for initializing, configuring, and managing accelerator systems (such as TPU, GPU, and CPU) within the TensorFlow DTensor framework. It includes functions to initialize an accelerator system for multi-client or local modes, set up collective communication, and shut down the system. Key functionalities involve configuring TensorFlow contexts, managing multi-client clusters, and integrating with TPU systems.

methods.description: Checks whether the accelerator system has been initialized.

methods.description: Sets the internal state indicating whether the accelerator system has been initialized.

methods.description: Configures and initializes the multi-client cluster for DTensor, setting up gRPC servers and collective communication.

methods.name: str initialize_accelerator_system( device_type: Optional[str] = None, enable_coordination_service: Optional[bool] = True, num_logical_cpu_devices: Optional[int] = None, experimental_reset_context: Optional[bool] = False, experimental_enable_megcore: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Main function to initialize accelerators (CPU, GPU, TPU) and communication fabrics for DTensor, supporting local and multi-client modes.

methods.name: None shutdown_accelerator_system()
methods.description: Shuts down the accelerator system, including TPU systems and resetting TensorFlow context.
